description: This script is a command-line interface tool for sending release-related emails for the Apache Superset project. It uses Jinja2 templates to generate email messages for voting, results, and announcements related to project releases.

classes.name: BaseParameters
classes.description: A class to hold version information and template arguments for email generation.

methods.name: string_comma_to_list
methods.description: Converts a comma-separated string into a list of trimmed strings.

methods.name: render_template
methods.description: Renders a Jinja2 template file with provided keyword arguments.
